'''Smooth Sandstone''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] replaces its vanilla recipe with a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 2 × {{MCW|Smooth Sandstone Slab}}), a [[Mud Kiln]] recipe (from [[Sandstone]]) and a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from {{MCW|Smooth Sandstone Stairs}}). See {{MCW|Smooth Sandstone}} for everything else.
